latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Create AI — quickly generate videos from images, clips, or prompts using AI.

- Upload images (JPG, PNG) or video files (MP4, MOV, and more; up to 500MB).
- Describe the video you want—AI generates a 30s promo, adds background music, overlays text, etc.
- No complex setup: backend handles rendering, timelines, and exports on the cloud.
- User-friendly workflow: automatic session/token handling, quick previews, and simple exports as MP4.
- Supports marketers and creators who want fast, high-quality videos without manual editing.
